study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Zhang et al., Journal of Affective Disorders, 2023
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Parsing the heterogeneity of brain-symptom associations in autism spectrum disorder via random forest with homogeneous canonical correlation

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Multivariate linear regression model for regional GMV; quadratic age term selected.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: we fitted a multivariate linear regression model for the regional GMV by age, gender and TIV using the controls. There were four options for the highest order of age in the regression model: 1, 2, 3, and 4. Through BIC (Bayesian Information Criterion), we found that the model was the best when the highest order of age was 2

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Gray matter volume (VBM), regional GMV across 140 brain regions (AAL3).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Voxel-based morphometry (VBM) was used to compute gray matter volume (GMV).; The automated anatomical labelling 3 (AAL3) atlas (Rolls et al., 2020) was used to extract gray matter volumes of 140 brain regions
